definitions.gloss: to position; to situate; to place in context; to define the role of
definitions.explanation: To assign a particular position, role, or significance to something within a larger framework. Often used in academic, business, and policy discussions to describe how something is categorized or valued.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{最重要課題|さいじゅうようかだい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{位置|いち}づける。
examples.english: To position this policy as the most important issue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{環境問題|かんきょうもんだい}→環境問題：10136_kankyoumondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{国際協力|こくさいきょうりょく}→国際協力：22688_kokusaikyouryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{柱|はしら}→柱：05009_hashira⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{位置|いち}づけて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Japan positions environmental issues as a pillar of international cooperation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{文学史|ぶんがくし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦どのように→どのように：23674_donoyouni⟧{位置|いち}づける⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧、⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Debate continues among scholars about how to situate this work within literary history.

notes:
USAGE:
{位置|いち}づける is a transitive ichidan verb. It is commonly used in the pattern A⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧B⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{位置|いち}づける (to position A as B).

ASPECT (ている):
{位置|いち}づけて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing stance or characterization.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [thing]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧[role]⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{位置|いち}づける (to position something as a role)
- [thing]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧[context]⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{位置|いち}づける (to situate something within a context)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{位置|いち}づける (to position as important)
- ⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{位置|いち}づける (to position at the center)
- ⟦{位置|いち}づけ→位置づけ：20518_ichizuke⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧ (difficult to categorize)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{位置|いち}づける focuses on assigning significance within a framework. ⟦{分類|ぶんるい}する→分類する：25224_bunruisuru⟧ means to classify or categorize and is more about sorting into groups.
